en: A black‑and‑white historic view of a crowded promenade beside a narrow river in a European spa town. On the left is a long neoclassical colonnade with arches, columns, balustrades and statues on the roof. Hundreds of well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing and hats stroll along the wide walkway, some carrying umbrellas. On the right side of the image are multi‑storey historic buildings lining the river and continuing into the distance along a curving valley.
